title: Concept: ngrok tunnel URL in a response
description: An ngrok tunnel host name in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: A tunnel exposes a developer machine to the internet under a public host that changes without review, and it bypasses the network controls the production path depends on.
applicability: Webhook callbacks, payment sandboxes and demo environments.
risk: An open tunnel reaches a laptop with development credentials and no monitoring.
